kebab_example: aliyun cgcs list-instances --project-id 4820372607851300489003 --instance-type gcs.r1c1m1.1xlarge --district-id huadong --instance-id gcs-bmt0kbn7e013aedg9 --next-token BEXZPF01W23U46598WVf --max-results 20 --status CREATING --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstances

parameters.help_en: The project ID. If not specified, instances from all projects are queried
parameters.help_zh: 项目ID，不填默认查询所有项目下的实例
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type of GCS. If not specified, all instance types are included
parameters.help_zh: GCS 实例的规格，不填默认所有实例规格
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The district ID. If not specified, all districts are included. Valid values:

huadong

xinan

huanan

huabei

huazhong
parameters.help_zh:
大区ID，不填默认所有大区。取值：

huadong

xinan

huanan

huabei

huazhong
parameters.name: district_id

parameters.help_en: The list of GCS instance IDs to query. If not specified, all instance IDs are included
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的云渲染实例 ID 列表，不填默认所有实例 ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The token returned from the previous query. Leave empty for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 上一次查询返回的 Token，首次查询可为空
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results. Valid values: 1 to 200. Default: 200
parameters.help_zh: 最大结果数。取值范围 1~200，默认值 200
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The status of GCS instances. Valid values:

CREATING: Creating

RUNNING: during instance runtime

OPERATING: O\&M

DELETING: Deleting

MIGRATING: instance migration
parameters.help_zh:
云渲染实例话状态，包括：
CREATING：创建中
RUNNING：实例运行中
OPERATING：实例运维中
DELETING: 实例删除中
MIGRATING: 实例迁移中
parameters.name: status
